tool.name: Qwen 2.5-VL (72B)
tool.summary: Vision-language foundation model capable of reading hour-long videos, parsing fine-grained document charts, and operating computer UIs via agent grounding.
tool.architecture: Dynamic resolution Vision Transformer (ViT) paired with Qwen 2.5 language backbone.
tool.usage:
from transformers import Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, AutoProcessor
model = Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tool.limitations: High token consumption on long video streams.
